name: brownfield
description: Add link expiry to the existing service. Shows: impact analysis on real code, planner inserts a migration-check stage at runtime, schema change needs tech-lead approval, injected first-attempt bug caught by tests → journal rollback → rework → re-approval → recovery (MTTR).
requirement: Add link expiration: a link can carry an optional expiry time, and once it has expired the redirect must return 410 Gone.
